My notes: The brewery / restaurant is located in the office park area. They have special lunch menu as well as daily specials. One such offers is a burger and a pint of beer for $18. The following beers were available as of 8/19/26: Honey Pot Blonde (ABV ~5%), a California-style dry-hopped blonde ale that's light and approachable with subtle floral hop character; Citra Pale Ale (ABV ~5.8%), a dry-hopped American pale ale with bright, citrusy notes; IPA (ABV ~7%), a classic dry-hopped California IPA that's bold and resinous; Pub Ale (ABV ~5.2%), an American amber ale with a balanced malt backbone; Almond Brown Ale (ABV ~5.4%), a classic American brown ale with a nutty, toasty edge; Hopical Paradise (ABV ~4.8%), a dry-hopped American-style wheat beer that's light-bodied with tropical hop aromatics; Mohazeic (ABV ~7%), a hazy New England IPA that's juicy and soft on the palate; Octavian (ABV ~8.5%), a double dry-hopped Imperial IPA and the heavy hitter of the lineup; El Pato Loco (ABV ~4.8%), a crisp, sessionable Mexican-style lager; and Seasonal Draft Ale, a rotating seasonal offering worth asking about.

The brewery / restaurant is located off Rt.140 in the heart of small town Mariposa, CA. They brew the beers up the street. They have a good option for food as well. The 1850 medium rare burger with fries is pretty good. The Timberline pale ale is the best after a long day of hike. As of 8/19/26 their 4 pack costs $15.
